title: Every member sees the to-dos handed to them across Spaces in an Inbox To-dos view

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: /admin/work is the only cross-Space to-do list and it is staff only (requireAdmin janitor). A Space owner or teammate who is not staff can only find their to-dos one Space calendar at a time. Fix: a To-dos view in /inbox beside Priority, Other and Snoozed, reading the same rollup (lib/work/rollup-core.ts) for the viewer's Spaces; Work stays the staff rollup (owner ruling 2026-11-24).

Inbox has a To-dos view: open Plan to-dos handed to you plus unclaimed ones on Plans you own, across every Space, overdue first, each linking to its Plan.
